notes: Soft gap: inputs mix text, tables, Excel workbooks and images, and the serialization of workbooks into the <excel> field follows the released code. Correctness is judged by GPT-4o with a printed prompt (snapshot 2024-05-13 by Appendix A). Long contexts make calls expensive; 466 tasks x 3 seeds.

resolution.plan: Use the repository's 466 data-analysis tasks together with its serialization of Excel workbooks, tables and images into the Appendix C template fields (<introduction>, <excel>, <question>). Run gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 model-only, judge each answer against the gold answer with the printed judge prompt on gpt-4o (2024-05-13 while callable, else the current alias), and compare task-level accuracy with 25.97 (Table 4).
resolution.approximation: The judge snapshot may differ; image-bearing tasks depend on how the repository passes images to GPT-4 Turbo; long contexts make the run costly.
